title: Inflation eased. Fuel did not.
gapNote: Seconds held after each voice line ends, before the next shot cuts.

endCard.title: Inflation eased. Fuel did not.
endCard.source: Data: Department of Statistics Malaysia, Consumer Price Index. CC BY 4.0.

shots.claim: The price level is 37.6% above 2010. One year of that is 1.8%.
shots.caption: 137.6 against 100 in 2010. One year is 6.4% of the climb.

shots.claim: Transport is heating while housing cools.
shots.caption: Transport 2.5%. Housing 1.4%. The tick is August.

shots.claim: The headline has not moved in three years.
shots.caption: Three years inside a 1.1% to 2.0% band.

shots.claim: The fuel shock is a subsidy wedge, and it is still open.
shots.caption: RON95 averaged RM4.18. The subsidised price is RM2.05.

shots.claim: The national number hides a spread of nearly five to one.
shots.caption: 0.5% in Sarawak. 2.4% in Negeri Sembilan and Labuan.

shots.claim: The same fuel shock does not land evenly.
shots.caption: Urban transport 2.75%. Rural transport 1.35%.
